title: Just for fun
text: Just for fun. This is kind of cheaply made, but we only bought it for a bit of fun to hang in our daughter's room (she wants to travel the world some day). There are only a limited number of flags, so it's not *quite* as international as we wanted, and I don't think it will last very long. But, again, it was only meant to be some temporary decor anyway. It's fine for that use.
